analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간을 탈출했으나 여전히 중립권에 머물고 있으며, MACD 히스토그램은 악화되며 약세 수렴을 지속하고 있다. 거래량은 급증했으나 가격은 스윙 저항선($236.53)에 막혀 횡보 중이다.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has exited oversold territory but remains in neutral territory, and the MACD histogram is worsening, continuing its weak convergence. Volume surged, but price is consolidating sideways, hitting the swing resistance at $236.53.

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) — 스윙 저항 돌파 시 매수 고려
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($235.50) vs SMA5 ($231.30)/SMA20 ($242.41)/SMA50 ($246.38) — Short-term trend above, mid-term trend below.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($242.06)/SMA200 ($234.75) — Mid-to-long term trend slightly weak.
· 52-week position (47.8%) + Current price level is historically moderate.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.6→44.4) — Attempting to enter neutral territory after exiting oversold.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.2973→-1.4955) — Worsening, continuing weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $242.41) — Bandwidth at 12.55%, indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($226.88) — Based on 5-day/20-day lows.
· Swing resistance ($236.53) — Based on recent highs and pivot; a breakout could signal a bullish reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low / Sideways) — Maintaining a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.44x vs 5-day average) — Surge in volume increases confidence in the move.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Consider buying on a breakout of swing resistance.
analysis.patternNote: 현재 가격은 5일 및 20일 저가 수준에서 횡보하며, 스윙 저항선 돌파 여부가 단기 방향성을 결정할 것이다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price is consolidating at the 5-day and 20-day low levels, with the breakout of the swing resistance line to determine short-term direction.
keyPoints: RSI는 과매도 탈출 후 중립권에서 방향성을 탐색 중이다.
MACD 히스토그램은 악화되며 약세 수렴을 지속하여 추가 하락 가능성을 시사한다.
거래량 급증에도 불구하고 가격은 스윙 저항선에 막혀 횡보하며 매물대 소화 여부가 관건이다.
keyPointsEn: RSI is exploring direction in neutral territory after exiting oversold.
MACD histogram is worsening and continuing weak convergence, suggesting potential for further downside.
Despite a surge in volume, price is consolidating at the swing resistance, making digestion of supply the key.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 18.8로 추세 미형성 구간에서 거래량 급증이 발생하여 충격성 변동 가능성이 높다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 18.8, a surge in volume occurred in a non-trending phase, indicating a high probability of shock-like volatility.
analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독이 이어지고 있다. RSI는 과매도 탈출 후 중립권으로 진입했으나 MACD 히스토그램은 악화되며 약세 수렴을 지속하는 등 지표 간 혼조세를 보이며 관망세를 유지한다.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has entered neutral territory after exiting oversold, but the MACD histogram is worsening and continuing weak convergence, showing mixed signals that warrant maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
